response: Saved Views is available today, included in all paid plans, and designed to help your team spend less time resetting filters and more time getting work done. Instead of rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a board, you can now capture the exact configuration you rely on and return to it instantly with a single click. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to cover every project, priority level, or workflow stage you track regularly. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating it on their own, keeping reporting and planning consistent across the group. Whether you're following overdue tasks, monitoring an active sprint, or checking priority items across multiple projects, Saved Views keeps your most useful perspectives just a click away. There's no setup fee, no extra cost, and no limit on how you organize your work. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
